## About this page

Keys that work while the WM Pass window is in front. Choose one to change it.

#### How it works

- <kbd>Ctrl+F</kbd> (<kbd>⌘F</kbd> on a Mac) **Search**: puts the cursor in the search box, going back to the list first.
- <kbd>Ctrl+N</kbd> (<kbd>⌘N</kbd> on a Mac) **New item**: starts an item of the first type in the [add menu](/guide/settings/add/#setting-add-kinds).
- <kbd>Ctrl+E</kbd> (<kbd>⌘E</kbd> on a Mac) **Edit item**: opens the item you are looking at in the editor.
- <kbd>Ctrl+L</kbd> (<kbd>⌘L</kbd> on a Mac) **Lock**: locks the vault.
- <kbd>Ctrl+G</kbd> (<kbd>⌘G</kbd> on a Mac) **Password generator**, <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+C</kbd> (<kbd>⌘⇧C</kbd> on a Mac) **Codes**, <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+H</kbd> (<kbd>⌘⇧H</kbd> on a Mac) **Health** and <kbd>Ctrl+Comma</kbd> (<kbd>⌘,</kbd> on a Mac) **Settings** go to those pages.
- <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+P</kbd> (<kbd>⌘⇧P</kbd> on a Mac) **Copy password**, <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+U</kbd> (<kbd>⌘⇧U</kbd> on a Mac) **Copy username** and <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+O</kbd> (<kbd>⌘⇧O</kbd> on a Mac) **Copy code** copy from the item you are looking at.
- <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+L</kbd> (<kbd>⌘⇧L</kbd> on a Mac) **Open site**: opens that item's website.
- <kbd>Ctrl+Backslash</kbd> (<kbd>⌘\</kbd> on a Mac) **Show or hide the sidebar**.
- <kbd>Ctrl+K</kbd> (<kbd>⌘K</kbd> on a Mac) **Quick search**: puts the cursor in the search box of the list you are on.
- <kbd>F1</kbd> **What is this page?**: opens the guide at the topic for what is on screen.

Some keys are fixed: the arrow keys move through the list, Enter in the search box opens the chosen item, Escape clears the search, and Ctrl+S or Cmd+S saves in the editor.

#### Limits

In the desktop app, the shortcut that opens quick search from anywhere on the computer is set under Settings, Desktop.

#### On Android

Keys for a keyboard plugged in or paired with your phone. Tap one to change it.

- <kbd>Ctrl+F</kbd> (<kbd>⌘F</kbd> on a Mac) **Search**: opens search.
- <kbd>Ctrl+N</kbd> (<kbd>⌘N</kbd> on a Mac) **New item**: opens the add menu.
- <kbd>Ctrl+L</kbd> (<kbd>⌘L</kbd> on a Mac) **Lock**: locks the vault.
- <kbd>Ctrl+G</kbd> (<kbd>⌘G</kbd> on a Mac) **Password generator**, <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+C</kbd> (<kbd>⌘⇧C</kbd> on a Mac) **Codes** and <kbd>Ctrl+Shift+H</kbd> (<kbd>⌘⇧H</kbd> on a Mac) **Health** go to those pages.
- <kbd>Ctrl+Comma</kbd> (<kbd>⌘,</kbd> on a Mac) **Settings**: opens Settings.

See also [Keyboard shortcuts](/guide/settings/shortcuts/#setting-shortcuts-desktop), [Main window](/guide/screens/#screen-window).

<a id="setting-shortcuts-desktop"></a>

## Keyboard shortcuts

*Only in the desktop app and the browser extension.*

Your own keys for the actions on this page, used in place of the usual ones.

#### How it works

Choose a shortcut, then press the keys you want. **No shortcut** leaves that action without one, and **Cancel** or Escape keeps it as it was.

One set of keys does one thing. Giving keys to an action takes them from whatever had them.

**Back to the usual keys** puts every shortcut back as it started.

#### Limits

Shortcuts work even while you type in a field, so a key without Ctrl, Cmd or Alt, such as a plain letter, would fire each time you type it.

They are saved with your other customizations, so a settings file carries them to another computer.

See also [Settings file](/guide/settings/file/).

## Keyboard shortcuts

*Only in Android.*

Your own keys for the actions on this page, for a keyboard plugged in or paired with your phone.

#### How it works

Tap a shortcut, then press the keys you want. **No shortcut** leaves that action without one.

One set of keys does one thing. Giving keys to an action takes them from whatever had them.

**Back to the usual keys** puts every shortcut back as it started.

See also [Settings file](/guide/settings/file/).
